name: Winds Of Love
source:
A set of unlucky events locks up you, your ex-fiancé, and a new guy, who accidentally walked into your life, together. Will you let the winds of love take you to a new romance, or will you go back to what you once had and give your ex a chance?

[From in-app]
translation:
一连串倒霉事将你、你的前未婚夫，以及一名意外闯入你生活的新面孔困在了一起。你会让爱情之风带你开启一段新的恋情，还是回到曾经的感情中，再给前任一次机会？

[摘自应用内介绍]
